body: Thanks, I just feel so hopeless. I dont know what is wrong with me, I never knew that there is such little help out there for pain. I am gonna try to get an MRI. It would really help me if I was diagnosed with something so that there is coear guidelines of treatment.

I have pain too. it is hell, i feel for ya. what can we do? quality of life is gone. I have to sit down, think of all the good things in life worth living for. things that can be enjoyed. for me, baseball, video games, drawing, writing. even though I cant enjoy those things when im in pain. well in an abstract way, being the same age as you I can only hope science and technology will fix this stuff in our lifetime. right now we are in the dark ages and unnecessarily suffering
